page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.c2 family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and features 16 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 32.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core, aligning the instance with compute-intensive hardware profiles.

The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. There are no integrated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this server type.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is designed for workloads that require consistent CPU performance without massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include web serving, batch processing, and distributed analytics. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable performance for compute-bound tasks, avoiding the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable instances.
